POSITIONING: Kiln is a small ceramics studio in Galway. We throw, glaze and fire cups and bowls in small batches, sell them from the studio and online, and teach people to make their own.
VALUE_1_LINE: Every piece is thrown, glazed and fired in the studio, so no two are the same.
VALUE_2_LINE: Cups and bowls built to be used every morning, not kept on a shelf.
VALUE_3_LINE: Visit, watch the wheel, take a class. The studio is the shop.
AUDIENCE: For people in Galway who want everyday things made by hand
LOGO_NOTE: The kiln's arched door with the fire inside · lowercase wordmark in Space Grotesk 700
CLEAR_SPACE_RULE: x = the height of the letter n
BASE_ROLE: The studio's colour: large surfaces, packaging, the shop sign.
LIGHT_ROLE: Unglazed clay: cards, labels and text on Clay. Never pure white.
INK_ROLE: Text on Bisque and Ember, dark cards. Never pure black.
ACCENT_ROLE: The fire in the kiln: buttons, the dot, glows. Use it sparingly.

BODY_SAMPLE: We throw, glaze and fire small batches of cups and bowls, and teach people to make their own.
TYPE_RULE: Headlines in Space Grotesk bold; one word in Fraunces italic; labels in Geist Mono capitals.
FONT_LICENCE_NOTE: Space Grotesk, Fraunces and Geist Mono: SIL Open Font Licence (Google Fonts)
GL_BUTTON: Ember with a char chip and an arrow. It glows like a kiln window.
GL_GLOW: Warm light drifting behind the content, like heat from the kiln.
GL_CARDS: Rounded 22 to 28 px, Bisque on Clay, an ember edge glow on the hero.
GL_DOT: The ember full stop closes headlines, like the one in the wordmark.
GL_HAIR: Three short rules and mono labels give structure without boxes.
GL_PILLS: Small mono pills for navigation; the current one fills Bisque.
VOICE_DO:
• Say who it's for and what they get: “Handmade cups for people who love their mornings.”
  • Talk about the making: the wheel, the glaze, the firing.
  • Short, warm, plain sentences.
  • Name the place: Galway, the studio, the kiln.
VOICE_DONT:
• Empty slogans: “Crafted with passion.”
  • Invented awards, press or numbers.
  • Luxury talk: exquisite, bespoke, curated.
  • More than one call to action on a screen.

CONTACT_LINE: A fictional brand, made with Claude Brand Kit
PURPOSE: To bring handmade ceramics into everyday mornings.
VISION: A studio and shop in Galway that people visit on purpose, and a small online shop shipping across Ireland.
MISSION: We throw, glaze and fire small batches of cups and bowls, and teach people to make their own.
PERSONA: Works in Galway city, buys gifts that mean something and follows makers on Instagram. She wants a cup she'll reach for every morning, and one day she'd like to make one herself.
PERSONA_NEEDS:
• Pieces that feel personal
  • Gifts that tell a story
  • A class to try it herself
PERSONA_NOW:
• High-street homeware
  • Online marketplaces
  • Craft fairs, now and then
PERSONA_WORRIES:
• Paying craft prices for something fragile
  • Breakages in the post
POSITIONING_STATEMENT: For people in Galway who want everyday things made by hand, Kiln is the ceramics studio that makes cups worth keeping, because every piece is thrown and fired in a room you can visit.
PROMISE: Made by hand, for every morning.
DIFFERENCE: A studio you can walk into: you see the wheel, the kiln and the person who made your cup.
PILLAR_1_LINE: every piece made in the studio
PILLAR_2_LINE: made to be used, not kept in a cupboard
HEADLINE_OPTIONS:

  • Learn to make the cup you'll drink from.
